messages.Text: which hospitals use ABDM in Pune

reply.Text:
I don't have access to a hospital directory or ABDM adoption registry. The ABDM developer portal documentation I can access covers how to *integrate* with ABDM gateways (HIE-CM, UHI, NHCX), not which healthcare facilities have already done so.

To find hospitals in Pune using ABDM, you'd want to check:
- The official **ABDM website** (abdm.gov.in) or **NHA portal** for provider registries
- Individual hospital websites (many list their ABHA/ABDM integration status)
- Direct inquiry with hospitals in the region

If you're building an integration with ABDM and have technical questions about the gateway APIs, FHIR profiles, or the integration flows, I can help with those using the developer documentation.
